resources.string: Your phone becomes a control surface for your Windows laptop, over Bluetooth.

1. Pair this phone with the laptop in Bluetooth settings.\n2. Run Edgepad.exe on the laptop; it lives in the system tray.\n3. Tap your laptop on the next screen. Edgepad remembers it and reconnects when it opens.

Press and hold a dial to arm it, then drag around it like a camera\'s zoom ring. Sweep up on the sides or right along the top and bottom to raise the value. A tap without a hold runs the dial\'s action: mute, play/pause, task view, reset zoom. Settings lets you put any dial anywhere along the edges, corners included.

One finger moves the pointer; tap to click; tap, then hold and move to drag.
Two fingers scroll in any direction; pinch to zoom; tap for a right click.
Three fingers left or right switch desktops; up opens task view; down shows the desktop; tap searches.
Four fingers left or right walk the app switcher; tap opens notifications.
Press back to leave the controls.
Pair this phone with the laptop in Bluetooth settings first, and keep Edgepad running on the laptop.

For each dial, choose an edge and slide it along that edge. The ends of the slider are the corners; a little way in keeps a dial clear of a rounded screen corner. Off hides it.
